records.name: Michael - Portfolio Website Template
records.description:
Michael is a free Astro template for designer portfolios. It is built for designers, freelancers and small studios who want a clean, professional site to show their work and attract clients.

What's inside:
- Home page with a hero, services, selected works, client reviews and a call to action
- About page with a story, experience and process sections
- Works section powered by a typed content collection, with four sample case studies you can replace with your own
- Contact page

Built with Astro 7, plain CSS and GSAP animations, with no CSS framework and no required backend, so it deploys as a static site anywhere. Requires Node.js 22.12 or newer.

records.name: Midnight Lite
records.description:
Midnight Lite is a free, dark landing page template for AI and SaaS products, under the MIT license.

Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, TypeScript. One page: a header, a hero with a night sky and an engraved guilloche rosette, product tiles with cited sources, a closing call to action and a footer, laid out separately for phones. Every word sits in one file, and AGENTS.md and DESIGN.md tell your AI editor how the page is built.

The theme and sections also install one by one with npx shadcn add from the @vilqor registry: midnight-lite.vilqor.com/r/registry.json

Code: github.com/vilqor/midnight-lite

The full Midnight adds seven more sections, working forms, analytics and a second language: templates.vilqor.com/midnight
